limitations: Source-derived educational composition, not measured registration or physiological lumen reconstruction.
Right atrial surface is unchanged. Lower SVC entry remains an overlapping gross wall sleeve, without a matched annulus or watertight weld; maximum finite ring-to-wall distance is 3.078 mm.
Dense sampled residual SVC-to-aorta side penetration is at most 0.283 mm in reviewed faces. No zero-collision claim.
Original source junction overlap and small retained fascia/ligament contacts remain documented.
No complete systemic or pulmonary venous circuit is claimed.
